eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN ADMINISTRATIVE MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Maricopa, AZ; at 7:05 AM on AUG 28, 2023 Effective until 5:05 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: A Silver Alert has been issued for Glendale Arizona  This is the Arizona Department of Public Safety.  Glendale Police Department is looking for  Thomas Alexander, 84 years of age, 5'9" tall, 170 pounds with gray hair and blue eyes. On 8/27/23 at approximately 8:00 pm, Thomas Alexander was last seen at his home located near 49th Ave and Butler. Thomas is 84 years old and suffers from a medical condition which may cause him to be lost and easily confused. There is no clothing description for Thomas, and he is most likely on foot. If you have contact with the Silver Alert, Please call 9 1 1.  Monitor TV and Radio for updates.
